fields.description:
# PL-2: Attribution Details

_Assigned BA and referrer attribution on the Player record, plus the set-once/flag-on-mismatch logic that keeps signups from getting blocked._

### FIELDS

* Assigned BA

* Lookup to Brand Ambassador. Reassignment is stamped in field history.

* Primary Referrer

* Lookup to Referrer. Entered on the first sign-up, then autofilled onto every later sign-up.

* Registration Date — Date.

* The date this player signed up with the agency.

* Secondary Referrer — Lookup to Referrer

* Who introduced the Primary Referrer; drives a milestone bonus, not a per-signup payout.

* Related Referrer Record — Lookup to Referrer

* For when this player is also a referrer.
* Cross-reference only, never merges records.

* Notes — Long text, general-purpose.

* Not referral-specific (e.g. used when a referral deposits using another player's book, naming the linked secondary referral so Finance can validate the payment).

### IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS 

* Field was labeled "Referral Notes";

* rename to general "Notes" — Joyce, 08/18: "I would just call it like notes in general, not referral notes."

* Assigned BA, Primary Referrer, and Secondary Referrer are all set from the player's first sign-up when blank; on a later mismatch

* flag for Ops review rather than blocking the sign-up — Kobi, 08/18. Same flag-don't-block pattern as PL-9's BA mismatch automation; this story only carries the fields, PL-9 owns the automation logic.

* Related Referrer Record is cross-reference only

* do not build any merge logic between Player and Referrer records.

### NOTES 

* Provenance: PL-2 (Player Record User Stories doc).
* Depends on the Player object existing first (PL-1).

### SOURCE 

* [Taryn doc PL-2 — Player Record User Stories](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1OSqt7ilS1feVS7aVxAYSsBZIcTrc1J31_WnQiVucEJg/edit)
* [Aug 18 Weekly Sync — Kobi Kunasekaran, 1:20:00 (BA/Referrer set-and-flag logic)](https://fathom.video/calls/787411922?timestamp=4800)
* [Aug 18 Weekly Sync — Joyce Kiddell, 1:21:12 (Notes field rename)](https://fathom.video/calls/787411922?timestamp=4872)
* Dependencies: [BUILD-173 — Player: Core Details fields](https://app.asana.com/1/1202721605677544/project/1215732799516730/task/1217684264652851)
* Owner (proposed): Taryn Reithofer
* Remember to update the requirements documentation as part of this change.
* Created 2026-08-20 from Player record documentation review.
